title: Mongo-sharded: per-RS quorum + balancer + shard registration health
description: Runs `nexus health mongo-sharded`: per-RS quorum (majority of 3) + single-primary + per-secondary replication lag, both mongos reachable, shards-registered count, and balancer state.

observe.what: all probes green: 3x quorum 3/3, 3x single-primary, per-secondary lag <10s, 2 routers alive, shards-registered=2, balancer=enabled
JSON HealthReport overallHealth=green; probe array covers all 3 RSes + routers + cluster-level shards/balancer

whatProves: MongoShardedAdapter.HealthAsync proves liveness at three layers: per-replica-set quorum/election, the mongos routing tier, and the config-server metadata (shard count + balancer) read through mongos.
